subject: Social Media
title: The Like Button
description: A fast breakdown of The Like Button for builders.

hook.text: Facebook added the Like button in 2009. A simple thumbs-up. It became the most addictive design in history.

buildup.text: Before Likes, engagement was comments—effortful and slow. The Like was one tap: instant feedback, zero friction.

discovery.text: Likes became social currency. Post quality was measured in Likes. Self-worth became quantified and public.

twist.text: Justin Rosenstein, who built the Like button, later called it 'bright dings of pseudo-pleasure.'

climax.text: Every platform copied it: hearts, upvotes, reactions. The Like button was the template for gamified approval.

punchline.text: One button reshaped how billions measure their worth.

quiz.question: Who built the Like button and later criticized it?
